== Published English Original Virtual Set 6 wording ==
The remaster drops the optional 1-Force activation and retrieves the topmost eligible Lost Pile character instead of putting it into hand. It directs both the top Reserve Deck card and the combat card to Lost Pile. The Imperial Barrier restriction, senator cost and Alter immunity remain. The [[:File:CC-D-abilityabilityability-decipher-archive.gif|underlying Decipher card]] already has the title dot.
